entities.name: Query protein / O16658
observations: Exact sequence match to reviewed Caenorhabditis elegans NSTP-4 (100% identity and 100% query/target coverage; E-value 5.1e-235).
Length 339 aa; estimated molecular weight 37.17 kDa; theoretical pI 9.03; predicted basic at pH 7 with charge about +5.8.
Annotated as a multi-pass membrane protein localized to the Golgi membrane.
Contains Pfam Nuc_sug_transp (PF04142.22), residues 8–326, and an EamA domain hit (PF00892.27), residues 94–163.

entities.name: Human SLC35A3
observations: Reviewed homolog Q9Y2D2 shares 57.3% identity over 95.0% query coverage and is annotated as a Golgi UDP-N-acetylglucosamine transporter.
Curated annotation describes UDP-GlcNAc import into the Golgi lumen coupled to UMP exchange, while noting that the precise role and independent transport activity remain under study.

entities.name: UDP-GlcNAc
observations: The reference protein is annotated to transport UDP-N-acetylglucosamine across the Golgi membrane.

entities.name: UDP-GalNAc
observations: The exact-match C. elegans reference is annotated to transport UDP-N-acetylgalactosamine, apparently simultaneously and independently with UDP-GlcNAc.

entities.name: Golgi nucleotide-sugar transport
observations: The protein is associated with transport of nucleotide sugars from the cytosol into the Golgi lumen, supporting luminal glycosylation reactions.
